To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
internal stakeholders are the key actors in implementing corporate entrepreneurship.

1) the involvement of internal stakeholders in the change process is a critical factor for the success of the implementation of corporate entrepreneurship, and 2) internal marketing strategies are a powerful tool to involve internal stakeholders during the change process.
the implementation of a corporate entrepreneurship strategy requires the development of a change process that involves internal stakeholders.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how top management can implement a change towards corporate entrepreneurship and what mechanisms can be used to involve internal stakeholders.
the question of how managers can use the internal stakeholders to enable organizational change towards corporate entrepreneurism.
the implementation of a strategy of corporate entrepreneurship within organizations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the implementation of corporate entrepreneurship is not only a matter of top managers' commitment and leadership but also a matter of the way in which internal stakeholders are engaged in the change process.

the implementation of corporate entrepreneurship is a complex process, and the success of the change process is highly contingent on the involvement of internal stakeholders and the ability of managers to communicate the change process effectively.
the implementation of corporate entrepreneurship requires an internal marketing strategy that focuses on involving internal stakeholders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the implementation of corporate entrepreneurship requires the involvement of internal stakeholders.
internal stakeholders are key players in driving the change process towards a corporate entrepreneurship strategy.
corporate entrepreneurship can be implemented by top managers through the use of a combination of internal marketing strategies, organizational mechanisms and managerial tools.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a corporate entrepreneurship strategy requires a top down approach and a change management effort in order to be successfully implemented.
internal marketing can be used to engage stakeholders in the change process.
internal stakeholders are key to the successful implementation of a corporate entrepreneurship strategy and the change process that accompanies it.
